ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: in the figure, two square modules connected in series can be seen, and each module is marked “D Latch” inside. The left-side input end is marked D, and the D signal enters the first D Latch. The Q output on the right side of the first latch is connected to the input end of the second D Latch. The final Q output is given on the right side of the second latch, and Q-bar outputs are also marked beside the two latches. At the bottom there is a clock line marked Clk; one branch of this clock line is directly connected to the En end of the first D Latch, and the other branch passes through an inverter with an inversion bubble and then is connected to the En end of the second D Latch. Reasoning: two D latches are connected in series, and their enable ends are controlled by opposite phases of the same clock, one directly controlled by Clk and the other controlled by the inverted Clk. This is exactly a master-slave structure: the first D Latch acts as the master, and the second D Latch acts as the slave. Therefore this circuit is a Master Slave D Flip Flop.
